privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Prototype draft. To be reviewed by the city's Data Protection Officer.
privacy.collectBody: Your barangay. If you want text alerts, your mobile number. If you make an account: your full name, mobile number, barangay and area, and an email only if you give one. If you send a report: its photos, the place you pinned and your note. If you book private hauling: the name and mobile number you give, the place, the photos and what you ask for. We don't ask for your ID.
privacy.whyBody: To show your barangay's schedule, text you before the truck arrives, keep your account, points and requests together, and answer your report or booking.
privacy.whoBody: Only the City ENRO staff who act on your reports, texts and bookings, and only what each task needs. The truck crew sent to a report sees its photos and place. It is never sold or shared.
privacy.rightsBody: You can stop texts anytime (reply STOP), change your account details in Settings, log out, and delete your data in Settings. Reports you sent stay with the City as records, no longer linked to you. This follows the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).
privacy.accountBody: An account is optional. It keeps your reports and points together, and lets you use them on another phone. Your password is never kept as typed. Reports and points stay on the device until you move them into an account.
